title: The reeve at Last Light Square told me 'The priest opened it for you, I hear, blessing and all,' but the priest had explicitly refused a blessing earlier ('I'll not open a door for a man who means to shut it on grief... Force it, or find another way') and I opened the barrow myself with 'put your shoulder to the doors (warden)'. The game misattributes my own action to an NPC who refused to help.
where: Last Light Square / talk to reeve -> 'the priest opened the barrow'
